from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/accounting")

    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):

    statement_df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(file_bytes))

    if "transaction_ref" not in statement_df.columns or "amount" not in statement_df.columns:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Invalid statement CSV structure")

    merged = pd.merge(statement_df, internal_tx_df, on="transaction_ref", suffixes=("_stmt", "_internal"))
    matched_data = merged[["transaction_ref", "account_id", "payee", "category", "amount_stmt", "amount_internal"]].to_dict(orient="records")

An attacker can probe reference codes to extract payees, account IDs, and transaction values belonging to other companies.

from fastapi import APIRouter, UploadFile, File, Depends, HTTPException, status
import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy.orm import Session
from sqlalchemy import text
import io

router = APIRouter(prefix="/accounting")

@router.post("/reconcile-statement")
async def reconcile_bank_statement(
    file: UploadFile = File(...),
    db: Session = Depends(get_db),
    user: AuthUser = Depends(get_authenticated_user)
):
    file_bytes = await file.read()
    statement_df = pd.read_csv(io.BytesIO(file_bytes))

    if "transaction_ref" not in statement_df.columns or "amount" not in statement_df.columns:
        raise HTTPException(status_code=status.HTTP_422_UNPROCESSABLE_ENTITY, detail="Invalid statement CSV structure")

    # Restrict database query strictly to user's organization_id
    query = text("""
        SELECT transaction_ref, account_id, payee, category, amount
        FROM financial_transactions
        WHERE organization_id = :org_id
    """)
    internal_tx_df = pd.read_sql(query, db.bind, params={"org_id": user.organization_id})

    merged = pd.merge(statement_df, internal_tx_df, on="transaction_ref", suffixes=("_stmt", "_internal"))
    matched_data = merged[["transaction_ref", "account_id", "payee", "category", "amount_stmt", "amount_internal"]].to_dict(orient="records")

    return {"matched_count": len(matched_data), "transactions": matched_data}
